result.description:
An established General Practice Superclinic is seeking a dedicated  General Practitioner  to join its cohesive team and assist with an existing and rapidly growing patient base. This busy centre operates on a  mixed billing  model and offers GPs the benefit of intelligent practice analytics (such as Cubiko) to support individual choices regarding patient fees and practice management. 

 The clinic is an established, modern centre with excellent facilities, including eleven doctor consultation rooms, a dedicated treatment room, and a small procedure room. Located in a prime position on the Eastern Shore, the centre offers both designated all-day parking for practitioners and high foot traffic from its close proximity to the region's largest mall and a bus station. The team composition is highly supportive, including an experienced administrative team and three full-time nurses to provide crucial assistance with treatment room activities and Chronic Disease Management (CDM) care, allowing the GP to focus on patient care. The centre is co-located with an Integrated Care Centre providing allied services such as physiotherapy, mental health support, and oral health services, with pathology, pharmacy, and imaging services conveniently located nearby. 

 The centre is classified as a  DPA approved location , making it an excellent option for doctors on the FSP, PEP, and other 3GA programs seeking to fulfil Fellowship pathway requirements. The practice champions clinical autonomy and offers highly sought-after flexible working arrangements. It provides extensive support for professional growth, including a partnership that simplifies and records CPD requirements, free in-house educational opportunities, and discounted registration for industry events. There is expanded support for GP Registrar Supervisors, and the clinic actively supports GPs in developing or pursuing special interest opportunities in areas like skin, aesthetics, and occupational medicine. 

 The role provides immediate patient demand and is situated in a location that offers substantial lifestyle benefits in a vibrant metropolitan area. The practice maintains a supportive team culture and is part of a larger network providing sophisticated operational services, ensuring the GP can practice efficiently with high patient flow and quality equipment. A  locum opportunity  is also available for those seeking a short-term commitment.   Apply Now
